scope: Disposable Docker Compose API and independent worker, fictional local case effects only. No public hosting, external delivery or availability claim.

checks.name: API requires workspace authentication and disables demo faults
API and independent worker run as UID/GID 10001
API and worker are distinct running containers
Both services share the same named persistent data volume
Independent polling worker creates one actual local case
Duplicate intake preserves job and local effect identity
Polling worker leaves unapproved refund without an effect
Approved local case completes through the independent worker
Jobs and case effects survive API and worker restart
API persists queued work while the separate worker is stopped
Restarted worker drains previously persisted work
Image HTTP health check passes on the running API
